svg.title: When a document counts as missing
svg.desc: Every run reads all pages of the documents and of the trash of Paperless. When a page came back short or empty, or the list changed during the scan, the run reports SCAN INCOMPLETE and counts no document as missing. Otherwise, a document in one of the lists starts its count anew, and one in neither list counts one more missing scan; after N scans in a row, its copy moves to the deleted folder, or is deleted when that is allowed, within the batch size.
